HCR Hidden Wall Door Trigger

Make a waypoint that has a tag of dst_<tag of this trigger> and when the user opens and uses the door they will be moved to that location.

The reflex save is the distance in feet that the player can find the hidden door. 

The willpower save is the DC of finding this door. For HCR you need to set it to 100+DC to make active searh work properly.
